## 1. Executive Summary & Biography

- **Entity**: Bipul Kumar
- **Known As**: BlazeNXT, blazenxt
- **Occupation**: Full-Stack Software Engineer, AI Bot Architect, Open-Source Creator
- **Location**: India
- **Languages**: English, Hindi
- **Engineering Philosophy**: "Build in public, ship as open source." Every project is built to solve practical challenges with minimal framework overhead, high reliability, and clean developer ergonomics.
- **Core Domain Focus**:
  1. High-concurrency Telegram Bot architectures (voice chat streaming, referral automation, media retrieval).
  2. Custom AI integrations (combining Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, and offline fallbacks into production bots and voice agents).
  3. Native Android & Android TV mobile applications using Flutter & Dart.
  4. Privacy-first, zero-knowledge client-side cryptography.
  5. Full-stack web platforms using TypeScript, Next.js, React, and pure PHP.

## 2. Technical Stack & Architectural Capabilities

### Languages
- **Python**: Expert. AsyncIO, Pyrogram, Telethon, PyTgCalls, FastAPI, Flask, Web scraping, FFmpeg audio/video pipeline processing.
- **JavaScript & TypeScript**: Advanced. Modern ESNext, React 19, Next.js App Router, Node.js, Web Crypto API, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Service Workers.
- **Dart & Flutter**: Advanced. State management, Material Design 3, Android TV D-pad focus handling, native platform channels, background service workers, Picture-in-Picture (PiP).
- **Go (Golang)**: Proficient. Concurrency primitives (goroutines, channels), high-speed Telegram bots, MongoDB official Go driver.
- **PHP**: Advanced Vanilla. Zero-dependency API design, custom router implementations, cURL-based LLM streaming, token bucket rate limiters without Redis.

### System Architecture & DevOps
- **Containerization**: Docker, Docker Compose, automated container health checks.
- **Linux & VPS Administration**: Ubuntu, Debian, systemd service daemonization, cron automation, reverse proxying with Nginx and Caddy.
- **CDN & Edge Networking**: Cloudflare Workers (custom reverse proxying, domain routing, asset caching), Cloudflare DNS management.
- **Security Engineering**: Symmetric & asymmetric cryptography, XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD), AES-256-GCM, Argon2id memory-hard key derivation, constant-time operations.

## 3. In-Depth Project Case Studies

### 3.1 VenomMusic (Audio Streaming Platform)
- **Problem**: Mainstream music streaming applications are plagued with intrusive audio ads, subscription paywalls, and heavy tracking telemetry.
- **Solution**: An ultra-clean, high-bitrate music client that streams at up to 320 kbps with synchronous LRC lyric display, offline caching, and instant playlist curation.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Intelligent dynamic catalog layer that decrypts stream URLs on demand.
  - Progressive Web App (PWA) with native-like Android APK distribution.
  - Zero registration or tracking required for end users.
- **Live URL**: https://venomm.dpdns.org
- **Android APK**: https://apkpure.com/p/com.blazenxt.venommusic

### 3.2 VibeTube (Flutter YouTube Client)
- **Problem**: Official YouTube applications enforce restrictive background playback barriers and aggressive advertisements.
- **Solution**: A native Flutter client that operates without Google Play Services or microG.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Reverse-engineered YouTube InnerTube API protocol integration.
  - Floating Picture-in-Picture (PiP) and uninterrupted background audio.
  - Integration with the community-driven SponsorBlock API to skip sponsor segments automatically.
  - Support for YouTube Shorts and YouTube Live streams.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/Code-Stride/VibeTube
- **Release Package**: https://github.com/Code-Stride/VibeTube/releases/latest/download/VibeTube-release.apk

### 3.3 Devil AI (Pure PHP Chatbot)
- **Problem**: Modern AI chatbot implementations are frequently burdened with heavy frameworks, gigabytes of node_modules, or complex Python environments.
- **Solution**: A complete AI conversational interface written in 100% pure vanilla PHP with zero Composer packages and zero external dependencies.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Multi-provider AI core supporting Google Gemini, Groq (Llama models), and OpenAI GPT endpoints.
  - Native IP-based token bucket rate limiter to prevent abuse on shared hosts.
  - Offline demo mode for zero-cost testing and UI verification.
- **Live Demo**: https://ai.blazenxt.in
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/blazenxt/devil-ai

### 3.4 vault100 (Zero-Knowledge Browser Cryptography)
- **Problem**: Cloud storage services possess access to user encryption keys or decrypt files on the server during processing.
- **Solution**: An open-source, client-side encryption utility where the server never handles plaintext or encryption keys.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Cascaded dual-layer cipher combining XChaCha20-Poly1305 and AES-256-GCM.
  - Memory-hard password hashing and key derivation powered by Argon2id.
  - Implemented entirely in the browser using Web Crypto API and WebAssembly workers for parallel chunk processing.
  - Compatible CLI and cross-platform vault file formats.
- **Live Demo**: https://vault100.blazenxt.in
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/blazenxt/vault100

### 3.5 RickyCC (High-Throughput Telegram Referral Engine)
- **Problem**: Viral Telegram marketing campaigns frequently overload traditional bot scripts when thousands of users enter simultaneous referral queues.
- **Solution**: A concurrent bot built in Go that interacts directly with MongoDB.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Goroutine worker pools managing channel subscription verification.
  - Atomic MongoDB operations guaranteeing fraud-resistant referral counts.
  - Autonomous code redemption and tracking engine designed for 24/7 continuous operation.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/blazenxt/RickyCC

### 3.6 tv-browser (Android TV Web Browser)
- **Problem**: Most web browsers ported to Android TV require a mouse pointer or physical trackpad, which breaks the couch TV experience.
- **Solution**: A Flutter web browser built specifically around the Android TV D-pad remote control.
- **Key Architectural Features**:
  - Spatial navigation algorithm allowing four-way directional buttons to jump seamlessly between clickable web elements.
  - Hardware-accelerated WebView rendering.
  - Quick-access bookmark wheel and full-screen media video mode.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/blazenxt/tv-browser
